{{Quote|These represent our best long-range scans of the debris field from the destruction of Taspan II.|Thavish|<ref name="Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>}}
A '''debris field''' in the [[Taspan system]] was created by a [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projector]] accident known as the [[Big Crush]] that caused the destruction of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taspan II]]. As of the [[Battle of Mindor]], the debris had not yet had time to settle into stable orbits.
